stories.headline: Albuquerque raid yields roughly 51 kg of fentanyl, the biggest powder seizure in DEA New Mexico history, and a newly hired state paralegal is held
stories.summary: Agents searching a northwest Albuquerque home on 29 October recovered about 44 kg of fentanyl powder, over 7 kg of fentanyl pills, some heroin and around 29 firearms.
